deities: Shiva (Shivalinga placed in the cave chamber)
Panchalingeshwara - five Shiva lingas (tradition says installed by the Pandavas during exile - verify)

history.dynasty: Multiple strata - Iron Age habitation; Satavahana, Kadamba, Chalukya, Hoysala, Vijayanagara finds (rock inscription of Kadamba founder Mayurasharma, ~345-450 CE, at the site's Bhairaweshwara/Bhairaveshvara temple)
history.period: Prehistoric (Iron Age) through Satavahana era; cave temple development later (verify)
history.summary: CSV DUPLICATE FLAG: 'Ankali Mutt' is NOT a separate temple, and NOT a mutt in the monastic sense - it is the local name of the Chandravalli Cave Temple documented as CSV row 479. Multiple independent sources state the Chandravalli cave temple 'is also known as the Ankali Mutt' - the name comes from saints of Ankalagi (Belgaum district) who came here for meditation (Wikipedia's Chandravalli article, nativeplanet, solopassport, bestbus, 2indians.in). Google/place listings carry both 'Chandravalli Caves' and 'Ankali Mutt' pins at the same ~3 km-from-Chitradurga location. RECOMMENDATION: dedup - merge rows 479 and 483. This record is kept as a pointer to 479; all facts (history, travel, visitor info, image) are shared with row 479.

name: Ankali Mutt
town: Chandravalli (~3 km from Chitradurga) - same site as CSV row 479; recommend dedup
town_description: Chandravalli is a valley site about 3 km from Chitradurga city, formed by the Chitradurga, Kirabanakallu (Cholagudda) and Jolagudda hills. A lake beside the cave temple and the surrounding forest make it a good bird-watching spot; the prehistoric settlement area excavated measures ~730 m x 730 m.
tradition: Hinduism (Shaivism) + prehistoric archaeological site - duplicate of CSV row 479

travel.road: From Chitradurga bus stand take a local taxi or auto-rickshaw (~2.9 km); ~500 m walk from the entrance to the cave; guides ~Rs 300 (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; visit in the morning - carry a torch (interiors are pitch dark, though ventilated and cool).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported 10:30 AM-5:30 PM (verify); free entry and parking reported (verify); beware of monkeys; not ideal for the claustrophobic.
